info.description: Open-weight mixture-of-experts coding model with 40 billion total parameters and 2.5 billion active per token, under the Apache 2.0 license. The announcement states a context window of up to 512k tokens and recommends staying within 256k tokens. No first-party API or price is published.

zh.description: 开源混合专家编程模型，公告写明总参数 400 亿、每 token 激活 25 亿，许可为 Apache 2.0。上下文窗口最高 512k tokens，并建议编程和其他任务保持在 256k tokens 以内。未公布第一方 API 或价格。
